decisionAuthority.notes: Capability registry, providers, normalizers, artifact writers, and Swift views may describe, execute, transform, persist, or render. They must not decide final-output precedence, evidence usability, or product mutation eligibility.

capabilities.title: Pi SDK Runtime Kernel
capabilities.description: Embeds @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent for sessions, ResourceLoader, extension tools, skills, prompts, and event streaming.

securityReview.summary: Pi package installed with --ignore-scripts; package declares Node >=22.19.0 while current local smoke ran on Node 22.17.0.

capabilities.title: Planner Runtime
capabilities.description: Builds an auditable planner envelope for chat, tool use, and long tasks.

capabilities.title: DeepSeek / Kimi Provider
capabilities.description: Routes text/tool calls to DeepSeek and image analysis to Kimi vision.

capabilities.title: Pi Tool Runner
capabilities.description: Executes permissioned local tools for WeChat x on-chain runtime objects.

securityReview.summary: Only local artifact reads/writes are pass by default.

capabilities.title: Attachment Runtime
capabilities.description: Copies user images into runtime artifacts and routes image analysis to Kimi.
policy: image external analysis pass by user preference

securityReview.summary: No API key or raw request body is persisted.

capabilities.title: Long Task Daemon
capabilities.description: Keeps sessions, tasks, stream events, and artifacts recoverable outside the Swift app lifecycle.

capabilities.title: Production Runtime Harness
capabilities.description: Owns session tree, branch lineage, invocation ledger, context events, compaction summary, review branch, and final read-model authority.

securityReview.summary: Phase 1 harness artifacts are written and asserted by smoke/business QA.

capabilities.title: Unified Context Plane
capabilities.description: Builds bounded context packs, source trust summaries, context event logs, and compaction summaries for all domains.

securityReview.summary: Host-only deterministic context pack; semantic retrieval remains future work.

capabilities.title: Multi-domain Evidence / QA Gate
capabilities.description: Separates evidence usability and content quality from policy permissions across Web3 and Office/Meeting outputs.
policy: QA judges content quality, Policy Gate judges action boundary

securityReview.summary: CMC split gate and deterministic reviewer are active; office QA starts as draft-only review contract.

capabilities.title: Output Guard
capabilities.description: Prevents raw internal fields, unsupported market numbers, provider payloads, or channel secrets from entering final output.

securityReview.summary: Final output guard is recorded in tool observations and final read model.

capabilities.title: Domain Prompt Registry
capabilities.description: Maps Web3, meeting minutes, document draft, document revision, and channel reply intents to bounded prompt contracts.
policy: does not decide publish or final precedence

securityReview.summary: Office prompt registry starts as local deterministic draft read-model contract.

capabilities.title: Meeting Minutes Draft
capabilities.description: Creates local meeting-minutes draft read models from bounded context and optional Alibaba Bailian cloud ASR transcripts.
policy: audio/video upload is explicitly labeled as Alibaba Bailian cloud ASR via temporary OSS URL
raw audio/video not stored in artifacts

securityReview.summary: Cloud ASR stores transcript and metadata only; raw media, provider request bodies, headers, and secrets are excluded.

capabilities.title: Office Document Draft
capabilities.description: Creates local PRD, technical plan, ops plan, or general document draft read models.
policy: cloud publish/overwrite blocked until QA/Policy/channel readiness

securityReview.summary: Draft-only tool writes bounded read model and does not call Feishu.

capabilities.title: Office Document Revision Draft
capabilities.description: Creates non-destructive revision overlay read models for comment/review scenarios.
policy: overwrite requires explicit target and future QA/Policy/channel readiness

securityReview.summary: Revision starts as draft-only overlay; live overwrite tool is blocked.

capabilities.title: Feishu Channel Dry-run Bridge
capabilities.description: Writes Feishu channel dry-run read models and channel capability matrix without invoking lark-cli, replying, publishing, or notifying.

securityReview.summary: No live Feishu action is executed in Phase 2 dry-run package.

capabilities.title: Markets Equity Research Draft
capabilities.description: Creates local equity and cross-asset research draft read models using prompt-framework and dispatcher taxonomy adapted into the current runtime.
policy: provider evidence and price snapshot are separately gated

securityReview.summary: No external CLI, slash command, or live equity MCP is exposed. Live provider remains deferred until adapter/auth/normalizer/gates/QA exist.

capabilities.title: Markets Research Dispatcher
capabilities.description: Maps compact user-facing Markets tasks to internal Discover, Analyze, Monitor, and Macro lanes without exposing raw workflow files.
policy: does not decide final output authority

securityReview.summary: Dispatcher writes a local plan and keeps final answer authority in agent-final-read-model-v1.

capabilities.title: Equity Provider Deferred Marker
capabilities.description: Records that live equity MCP data integration is deferred until provider adapter, auth, normalizer, evidence gate, price gate, and QA are implemented.

securityReview.summary: Provider integration is intentionally not enabled in this pass.

capabilities.title: Hermes Learning Proposals
capabilities.description: Future sidecar proposal lane for sanitized trajectory reflection; not active in the current runtime.
policy: does not auto-write prompt, memory, or registry

securityReview.summary: Kept as roadmap-only; no Hermes sidecar code is migrated in Phase 2.
